author: Inside Edition
description: A scary incident on the streets of Oklahoma City, when a man threw a molotov cocktail at another man in a wheelchair in broad daylight. Surveillance video shows the victim cross the intersection in his wheelchair, meanwhile the suspect seemingly just walks past him crossing another street. When the suspect reaches the other side of the street he does an about face and confronts the man in the wheelchair. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Molotov Cocktail Thrown At Man In Wheelchair On Street In Oklahoma

author: Inside Edition
description: A homeowner was fighting a fire in his backyard while naked. Instead of scrambling to put on his clothes, Wesley Howard ran out to battle the blaze that was threatening his home and a neighbor's. Wesley and his fiance were sound asleep outside their Seattle home when their neighbor woke them. Howard was cool as can be as he brought the fire under control while wearing not a stitch of clothing.
title: Man Fights Fire In His Backyard Completely Naked

author: Inside Edition
description: For months, a crow had been landing on a woman's head. Veterinary nurse Joni Kamlet could not believe it when the crow started using her head as a landing strip, and despite the occasional peck, she loves it. Social media loves it, too. "My jealousy is beyond words," wrote one fellow bird lover. Kamlet even has a name for her bond with the bird; she calls it a "crowmance."
title: Crows Keep Landing On This Woman's Head

author: Inside Edition
description: Sixteen-year-old Noah Walden is warning people about wire grill brushes after his encounter with one sent him to the emergency room and into surgery. After eating two cheeseburgers at a family BBQ, he felt intense pain for several days. His mother rushed him to the hospital, and a scan showed that he had a bristle in his intestine. Not only was he shocked by the damage caused by a small piece of metal, hospital staff were stunned, too. Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindall has more.
title: Minnesota Teen Has Emergency Surgery After Swallowing Bristle Brush Needle

author: Inside Edition
description: Inside Edition spoke with Jeff Tazzara and his son, who was saved by his faithful dog, Colton.
title: Brave Husky Rescues Child From Charging Bear #shorts
